description: This file defines the CurlHandler class within the GuzzleHttp\Handler namespace. It implements an HTTP handler that uses cURL easy handles for network requests, allowing configuration of options and executing requests accordingly.

classes.name: CurlHandler
classes.description: An HTTP handler that manages HTTP requests using cURL handles, supporting custom options and request execution.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CurlHandler with optional factory settings for cURL handle creation.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the execution of an HTTP request using cURL, including optional delay, and returns a promise.
